name: workbench
description: Workspace for issue briefing, brainstorming, convention-aware scoped execution, test briefing, API discovery, and dev wiki maintenance.

interface.longDescription: Workbench collects scoped work tools for Codex, including Jira issue briefs, selected-unit brainstorming, dev-wiki-aware guarded one-unit execution, goal-focused test briefing, linked Figma design inspection, registered Swagger/OpenAPI discovery, and project dev wiki maintenance.
defaultPrompt: Use $issue-brief to summarize this Jira issue.
Use $brainstorm to review the selected work unit before implementation.
Use $executor to implement one selected work unit with dev wiki conventions and scope guarding.
Use $test-brief to create tests before implementation.
